messages:
ana: Ok team — kicking off the SCION micro-cert sprint for SI onboarding. Goal: publish the hands-on lab, trainer playbook, and badging flow by end of Q2. Who can take the lab runbook?

michael: I can own the lab runbook. I'll convert the current sandbox steps into step-by-step tasks. ETA next Wed.

lina: I'll pair with Michael for infra prerequisites and a little script to provision the dev sandbox. Will need a short checklist for support docs.

ana: @michael @lina thanks. (typo fixed)

tara: I can draft the trainer playbook — outline + evaluation rubric. Quick q: do we want a practical lab (deploy + inference) or just guided exercises?

michael: Prefer practical. Minimal deploy: model pinned to rdx-v1-small, run a sample inference, and validate latency < 200ms on Dedicated. Keep infra lightweight though.

lina: For provisioning script, thinking a simple Terraform module + bash wrapper. Example usage in README: ```./provision.sh --env=si-sandbox --region=us-west1```

onboard-bot: Reminder: add new playbook to SI-Enablement Confluence page or it won't show up in certification pipeline.

tara: Good call. I'll create the Confluence skeleton and badge criteria. Proposal: 3 labs (intro, deploy, ops), each with passing checklist. Certification requires completing all 3 plus a short video demo.

michael: I'll link the lab steps to the CI eval harness so we can auto-check outputs (hash of response file, simple smoke tests).

lina: Heads-up: hardware partner (EdgeWave) needs a section on network setup for on-prem. I'll ping their integration PM for a short note.

ana: @lina can you loop in @kevin-edgewave? Add him to participants once he replies.

onboard-bot: Action assigned: lab-runbook -> michael (due 1746576000).

tara: Sync cadence? Weekly 30m until alpha ready. Thursdays 9am PT?
michael: Works for me.
lina: Works. I'll add calendar invite.

ana: Nice — next steps: michael starts runbook draft, lina starts provisioning script, tara starts playbook draft + Confluence. We'll post a short status update in #partnerships every Friday. :thumbsup:
